description: Single-value equality: the result is true only when the reference list holds exactly one item and that item is byte-for-byte identical to the probe value. A list with zero or multiple items never matches, and a multi-word probe is never split. The input is a list of checks, each with the reference 'arguments' and a single probe 'value'; for each check the output reports whether it matches.
